title: Your Bosch Induction Cooktop UNLOCKED: Features, Power & Easy Cooking | Bosch Home USA
description:
Unlock the magic of induction cooking with your new Bosch Induction Cooktop! Master cookware, FlexInduction, and AutoChef. Achieve precise heat, fast boils & easy cleaning. Get ready to revolutionize your kitchen experience! ▶ Find out more about cooking with Bosch: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=x937HbG1y6U&list=PLvR6J9EKAvE9XDClr5YU4c-g_wiBTWnS9&index=1

▶ Relevant models/SKUs included in this video*: NITP660SUC, NITP660UC, NITP060UC, NITP060SUC, NIT8660UC, NIT8660SUC, NIT8060SUC, NIT8060UC, NIT5660UC, NIT5060UC, NIT5460UC
*FlexInduction® is available on Benchmark models only: NITP660SUC, NITP660UC, NITP060UC, NITP060SUC
*AutoChef is available on all Bosch Benchmark and 800 Series Induction Cooktops only.

▶ For additional information, please refer to your owner manual or search the owner manual for your specific model here: https://www.bosch-home.com/us/owner-support/owner-manuals

▶ Subscribe now to get notified of the newest Bosch videos, Home Appliances, and insider tips: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCUoVa-mKZKTqVO8Qi2Bu6vQ?sub_confirmation=1
